scripts.extension:package: npm run extension:check && npm run extension:test && npm run extension:build && python3 apps/extensions/package.py
scripts.admin:lint: npm run format:typescript:check && npm run lint --workspace @devfeed/admin
scripts.admin:generate: uv run python scripts/export_admin_openapi.py && npm run generate --workspace @devfeed/admin
scripts.web:lint: npm run format:typescript:check && npm run lint --workspace @devfeed/web
scripts.format: npm run format:python && npm run format:typescript
scripts.format:check: npm run format:python:check && npm run format:typescript:check
scripts.extension:edge:package: npm run extension:check && npm run extension:test && npm run extension:edge:build && python3 apps/extensions/package.py edge
scripts.extension:edge:test:browser: npm run extension:edge:build && DEVFEED_EXTENSION_BROWSER=edge node --test apps/extensions/tests/*.browser.mjs
scripts.extension:build:all: npm run extension:build && npm run extension:edge:build
